summary: Independent review of Jinshu 109 units s0144-s0181 (job e4c72829c9af9b1992bd). All 28 owned claims are supported: Huang's 333 succession, 348 death at 52 sui and 352 retrospective title; Hui's onOrBefore-333 appointment; the undated mother; the 334 Liucheng and 338 Shi Hu and Duan events; and the 344 campaign and death, verified against Jinshu 108/110 and ZZTJ 95-97. Three omissions remain. Han's 333 defection and 334 counsel (p154), Han's 338 flight north and 340 escape and return (p161), and Yuwen Gui's 340 pursuit (p162) have no claims, so hints-p154/p161/p162 and those person checks fail. Duplicate identity records (p154/p161, p155/p164, p157/p160, p148/p163) persist and are left to the identity workflow. This is not a chapter or publication approval.
